name: Crocodile
publication: Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Stealth +2. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A broad olive-brown reptile with a long toothed snout, four short legs, armored ridges along its back and a tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement, August 8, 2014, version 1, printed and p. 7.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage and grapples it, escape DC 12. The victim remains restrained while grappled. The crocodile cannot Bite a different target until the grapple ends.
sections.At the table: Bite starts the grapple on a hit. The grappled creature may spend its action to try a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape.

name: Deer
publication: Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 12. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A slender russet-brown deer with a pale throat, split hooves and tall branched antlers in the reused stag portrait.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement, August 8, 2014, version 1, printed and p. 7.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

name: Elk
publication: Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A large tawny elk with a darker shaggy neck, broad branching antlers, slim legs and cloven hooves.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement, August 8, 2014, version 1, printed and p. 8.
sections.Traits: Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Ram that turn. The hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one prone creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: The printed Charge rider gives 2d6 additional damage without stating its type. The target’s save determines prone. Hooves is its own action against an already prone creature.

name: Giant Centipede
publication: Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement
otherStatistics: AC from natural armor. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 8. No listed languages.
appearance: A reddish-brown segmented arthropod with long antennae, curved venom claws, and paired ochre legs along its body.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Hoard of the Dragon Queen - Online Supplement, August 8, 2014, version 1, printed and p. 9.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. The creature makes a DC 11 Constitution save and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure. If this poison damage drops it to 0 HP, it is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after it regains HP. It is paralyzed while poisoned by this effect.
sections.At the table: A successful save avoids the poison damage. The special stable, poisoned and paralyzed effects require the poison damage itself to reduce the target to 0 HP.
